summary: gather_facts collects network device facts; network *_facts modules such as arista.eos.eos_facts accept gather_network_resources (for example interfaces) to return config as structured facts, while gather_subset mainly fetches operational data.
questions: What is the difference between gather_subset and gather_network_resources?
How do I gather interface facts from an Arista EOS device?

answer_card.title: gather_network_resources vs gather_subset
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- hosts: arista
  gather_facts: true
  gather_subset: interfaces
  module_defaults:
    arista.eos.eos_facts:
      gather_network_resources: interfaces
```
- `gather_network_resources`: configuration data as facts (interfaces, bgp, ospf, ...) under `network_resources`
- `gather_subset`: mainly operational data
